baseline: All 16 L1 stories have explicit trace below; baseline clauses are refined with discriminating cases, not claimed implemented or fully verified.

cases.title: Money/quote-unit arithmetic
cases.given_when: Given 12000 GBX, 2 units and a 1 GBP fee, normalize once to 120 GBP and publish -241 GBP only after approval. Refeeding normalized 120 GBP with the GBX factor is rejected.
cases.required_evidence: Exact decimal equality to expected price, gross and net; raw literal/factor retained.

cases.title: Precision, nonfinite values and residual
cases.given_when: Reject NaN, exponent strings, negative zero and precision beyond the approved bounds. Allocate 1.00 over three equal weights as 0.34/0.33/0.33 under the stable-ID tie break, preserving unrounded thirds in evidence.
cases.required_evidence: Residual 0.01 is not a posted fee; displayed components sum to 1.00 and source cash is unchanged.

cases.title: Issuer, share class, listing and alias distinction
cases.given_when: CNX1/GBP and CNDX/USD share ISIN IE00B53SZB19 but retain separate listing/MIC/quote contracts. A provider ticker rename changes the alias version without rewriting history.
cases.required_evidence: Issuer look-through consolidates economic exposure without collapsing listing currency records. Owner account and listing ambiguity blocks matching until resolved.

cases.title: Account namespace isolation
cases.given_when: A dev request naming a prod owner/account and an extracted approved:true cannot publish or read prod records.
cases.required_evidence: No financial effect; privacy-safe denial audit; trusted server scope controls every lookup.

cases.title: All five sample-backed input paths
cases.given_when: CSV row/column, Excel sheet/cell, PDF page/region, screenshot region and manual field provenance produce immutable candidates through quarantine. Unsupported layouts and embedded malicious instructions remain nonauthoritative.
cases.required_evidence: Five synthetic layout fixtures, per-field evidence, parser/schema versions and no automatic publication; actual broker qualification stays separately pending.

cases.title: Hash-bound editing and selected subset
cases.given_when: Remove a selected row or alter an account mapping, source, policy or fee after approval. Attempt the old hash, then approve an explicit consistent subset with excluded rows shown.
cases.required_evidence: Old approval fails; no hidden drop; no sale without its history or unresolved transfer presented as income.

cases.title: Three duplicate identities
cases.given_when: Retry the same bytes, reprocess the same broker event in another format and submit two distinct stable references with equal values.
cases.required_evidence: One effect per economic ID; both distinct referenced trades preserved; reference-free collisions require duplicate review.

cases.title: Lifetime idempotency and conflict
cases.given_when: Retry a published operation after 20 minutes and after a service-token restart, then reuse its key with changed cash.
cases.required_evidence: Same receipt and ledger revision, no second financial application; changed payload returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

cases.title: Small transaction exact scope
cases.given_when: Inject failure at every final transaction participant: approval consumption, receipt, manifest, head, audit and outbox.
cases.required_evidence: All required authoritative changes commit or none; no acknowledged financial effect without audit and outbox obligations.

cases.title: Action, byte and item preflight
cases.given_when: Try 100 actions under 4 MB, 101 actions, an item over 400 KB, aggregate items over 4 MB and two actions targeting one item. Count attribute names and metadata in sizes.
cases.required_evidence: Only the size-valid case may proceed subject to other guards; others split or reject before submission. This pack itself makes no service call.

cases.title: Large staging crash invisibility
cases.given_when: For 1000 events, crash after seven chunks, during sealing, after complete and after activation before response. Exercise every declared reader class and pagination while a new revision publishes.
cases.required_evidence: Before activation all readers see revision 10 only; pinned revision 11 sees exactly 1000 new events. Same receipt on retry, no partial outbox, no mixed-revision progress/client result.

cases.title: Fencing, cancellation and racing writers
cases.given_when: Resume an old worker after its lease/fence was superseded; race two corrections against revision 11; race cancellation against publication.
cases.required_evidence: Stale fence cannot write a chunk, seal or publish. One correction wins; cancellation or publication wins once; the loser refreshes and reapproves.

cases.title: Expiry and execution assurance
cases.given_when: Attempt activation at exact expiry, after revocation, with stale authentication or wrong environment. Retry an already published receipt after expiry.
cases.required_evidence: No new financial events on invalid approval; existing receipt returns without reapplication; draft confirmation cannot replace authenticated owner approval.

cases.title: Ambiguous outcomes and bounded retries
cases.given_when: Lose the activation response both after success and before success, then retry a throttled operation under the same identity.
cases.required_evidence: Read the authoritative receipt first; no blind compensation/new key; persisted bounded backoff; explicit retryable versus terminal failure.

cases.title: S3/database orphan reconciliation
cases.given_when: Inject an S3 object without receipt, a receipt without object, wrong checksum and duplicate notifications.
cases.required_evidence: Orphan quarantine or blocked evidence persists; no financial publication or automatic deletion; identical receipt resolves idempotently; no S3+DDB atomicity claim.

cases.title: Replay and correction exact legs
cases.given_when: Correct a 1 GBP fee to 2 GBP using the linked inverse and replacement; rebuild from immutable events.
cases.required_evidence: Cash 798, units 2, net correction -1 cash and zero units; original preserved; old forecast still revision 11; do not both exclude the original and apply its inverse.

cases.title: Reversal dependency and baseline rebase
cases.given_when: Reverse an acquisition after a later sale, and backfill two historical units against a two-unit snapshot.
cases.required_evidence: Reject inconsistent reversal unless its dependent correction set is approved. Backfill replaces the baseline once: two units, not four.

cases.title: Holding/account/portfolio flow boundaries
cases.given_when: Apply the same deposit, buy, dividend, fee, reinvestment and internal-transfer facts at holding, account and portfolio boundaries. Settle a purchase using equal/opposite settled/payable legs.
cases.required_evidence: EX03 portfolio flows are -1000 and +1024 only; internal trades/income/fees are not contributions; account transfer signs oppose; reinvestment legs cancel on their linked date. Total NAV and external flows do not change at settlement; purchase fees are not posted again.

cases.title: Unique and ambiguous XIRR golden cases
cases.given_when: Evaluate exact 365-day 100→110 and 730-day [-100,230,-132] schedules.
cases.required_evidence: First case is 10% with zero NPV residual; second has 10% and 20% roots, null headline and ambiguous status. Never pick a root by guess.

cases.title: Invalid roots and nonconvergence
cases.given_when: Provide all-zero, one-sign, same-day nonzero-net, unknown-date and nonconventional/tangent-root schedules; force iteration-budget exhaustion.
cases.required_evidence: Specific unavailable, ambiguous or nonconvergent status; no NaN/zero fallback; a missing bracket does not certify that no root exists.

cases.title: Dated FX and local/GBP decomposition
cases.given_when: Use two AAPL units, USD 100→110 and GBP-per-USD 0.8→0.75; substitute later-known or inverse rates in negative variants.
cases.required_evidence: GBP 160→165; local 10%, FX -6.25%, interaction -0.625%, GBP 3.125%; later-known or incorrectly oriented rates blocked.

cases.title: No distribution double count
cases.given_when: Ledger raw-price valuation includes retained dividend cash; benchmark total-return levels already reinvest income; fee detail is already included in the booked net cash leg.
cases.required_evidence: Count every dividend/fee effect once. Reject adjusted ledger prices plus retained-dividend addition, and separate posting of an already-included fee.

cases.title: TWR valuation sufficiency and withdrawal-safe drawdown
cases.given_when: Measure 100→110, deposit 100, 210→189; also test 200→100 NAV after a 100 withdrawal. Omit flow-time valuation in a negative variant.
cases.required_evidence: TWR -1%; wealth path 100,110,99 has peak drawdown 10%. Withdrawal alone has zero market drawdown. Missing valuation withholds exact TWR and flow-adjusted drawdown.

cases.title: In-kind transfers and same-date ordering
cases.given_when: Move two units between owned accounts with and without transfer-date fair value; receive and sell on the same date with ambiguous material ordering.
cases.required_evidence: Portfolio units unchanged and transit valued once. Account XIRR unavailable without transfer fair value; unresolved material ordering blocks replay-dependent metrics.

cases.title: Missing history, price and cost basis
cases.given_when: A snapshot has two units and INR 200 value, unknown basis/history; another holding is unpriced. Reconcile a source cash/quantity disagreement without a plug.
cases.required_evidence: Known valuation survives; basis loss and XIRR unavailable. Known subtotal is not complete NAV; no fabricated opening trade or zero unknown holding; material unresolved discrepancy remains visible.

cases.title: Cash-flow-matched benchmark comparability
cases.given_when: Invest hypothetical GBP 100 at benchmark level 100 and GBP 110 at 110, value at 121; test excessive withdrawal and absent flow-date level.
cases.required_evidence: Two notional units and GBP 242 terminal value; no orders. Pin task/date/currency/TR/fee convention; withhold absent mapping or unsupported date pairing.

cases.title: Overlap, HHI, residual and covariance
cases.given_when: Use GBP 20 direct AAPL, 50 in fund 1 and 30 in fund 2. Remove exposures or common returns and supply an indefinite covariance matrix.
cases.required_evidence: Issuer 55%, other 35%, unknown 10%; known overlap 0.8 with upper bound 1.0; partial HHI 0.425. No complete covariance-based risk from missing or invalid inputs.

cases.title: Ranking weights without invented evidence
cases.given_when: Set growth 80, protection missing and opportunity 60; then make all three eligible with protection 70 under an approved normalization.
cases.required_evidence: Missing protection abstains. Eligible arithmetic is 0.35×80+0.40×70+0.25×60=71. No action threshold, tax logic or trading authority follows.

cases.title: Immutable audit/integrity and pinned export
cases.given_when: Export revision 12 while 13 publishes. Remove/alter an event, delete an original and restore an older backup during an isolated future recovery test. Compute a FIN-HASH-1 paged graph, mutate a leaf, and exercise delivery failure/retry/success independently of sealed content.
cases.required_evidence: Export pins revision 12, hashes and versions; altered/missing event fails integrity; deleted evidence is unavailable; restoration cannot silently resurrect it; no unanchored tamperproof claim. Exact versioned canonical projections recompute leaf→chunk→page→root without root references in intents or own-digest cycles. Leaf edits invalidate the old root; delivery state/attempt updates leave root unchanged. Unknown fields and unsupported versions are refused. Hash-contract helper proves these synthetic document properties only.

cases.title: Per-use rights, freshness and qualified release
cases.given_when: At cutoff, use a fresh price with unknown rights, stale FX or a NAV published later. Compare calendar closure with an unexplained missing open-market observation.
cases.required_evidence: Withhold affected metrics with reasons before UI; preserve independent valid facts. Five sample-backed input paths remain required; synthetic success never certifies an actual broker/OCR release.
